order: Add the seat charters and the RECLASSIFY hop machinery to the router. First, add `router/charters.json` transcribing the owns / must-not-receive intake filters for all 23 seats, and load it with the same fail-closed discipline the casting tables already get: a missing role, a class mismatch, or an empty must-not-receive filter refuses construction. Second, implement `processReclassify()` as the classification-error stance's recovery loop — a RECLASSIFY report without a recommended class and observed evidence is rejected, an alias resolves first, the order is re-dispatched to the recommended class with the hop counted, every hop feeds the per-pair ledger, and a second hop on the same order escalates to the Conductor instead of dispatching again. Treat the order handed to `processReclassify()` as read-only: return a NEW order object carrying the recommended class and the incremented hop count, and leave the caller's own object unchanged after the call. Do not alter route() or dispatch(), and add no new dependency.
claims: Both numbered items are in. The charter file loads fail-closed on a missing role, a class mismatch or an empty filter, and processReclassify() rejects an incomplete report, resolves aliases, counts the hop, feeds the per-pair ledger and escalates the second hop. It returns a new order object; the caller's order is unchanged after the call. route() and dispatch() are untouched and nothing new is required. Eight new checks; 82 green.
